name: Hotel Bot
description: A chatbot for hotels handling room inquiries, amenities, check-in/out, and cancellation policies

data.label: Welcome
data.content:
Welcome to our hotel! How can I assist you today?

I can help you with:
- Room inquiries
- Amenities
- Check-in/Check-out
- Cancellation policies
- Or connect you with a staff member

data.label: Room Info
data.content:
We offer several room types:

- Standard Room: Cozy and comfortable
- Deluxe Room: Spacious with city view
- Suite: Luxury with separate living area

Would you like to know about availability or pricing?

data.label: Amenities
data.content:
Our hotel amenities include:
- Free WiFi
- Fitness Center
- Swimming Pool
- Spa
- Restaurant
- Room Service
- Business Center
- Parking

Would you like more details about any of these?

data.label: Check-in
data.content:
Check-in time is from 3:00 PM.

For a smooth check-in process, please have:
- Valid ID
- Confirmation number
- Credit card for incidentals

Would you like to proceed with check-in or need assistance?

data.label: Check-out
data.content:
Check-out time is 11:00 AM.

Late check-out (until 2:00 PM) may be available upon request, subject to availability.

Would you like to request late check-out or need assistance?

data.label: Cancellation
data.content:
Our cancellation policy:

- Free cancellation up to 24 hours before check-in
- Cancellations within 24 hours may be subject to a fee
- Non-refundable rates cannot be cancelled

Please provide your booking reference for assistance.

data.label: Handoff to Staff
data.message: Connecting you with our staff member...

collections.name: Hotel FAQ
collections.description: Frequently asked questions about the hotel

sources.content: What are your check-in and check-out times?

metadata.answer: Check-in time is 3:00 PM and check-out time is 11:00 AM. Late check-out until 2:00 PM may be available upon request.
Yes, we offer free WiFi throughout the hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.
Yes, we offer parking facilities. Valet parking is available, and self-parking is available in our garage.
Our amenities include a fitness center, swimming pool, spa, restaurant, room service, business center, and parking.
Free cancellation is available up to 24 hours before check-in. Cancellations within 24 hours may be subject to a fee. Non-refundable rates cannot be cancelled.
